parameters.command:
=cd <path-to-dmz-watchtower-compose-dir> || { echo '===RESULT:failed==='; exit 1; }
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  out=$(docker compose run --rm -e WATCHTOWER_NOTIFICATION_URL= watchtower --run-once {{ $('Find Retryable Failures').first().json.namesArg }} 2>&1)
  summary=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep 'Update session completed' | tail -1 | sed -E 's/.*msg="Update session completed" //')
  echo "attempt $attempt: ${summary:-no session summary}"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'level=(warn|error)|Found new image|Started new container' | grep -v 'Failed to retrieve image info' | sed -E 's/^time=[^ ]+ //' | cut -c1-300
  case "$summary" in
    *scanned=0*) echo 'container no longer exists, not retrying'; break ;;
    *failed=0*) echo '===RESULT:ok==='; exit 0 ;;
  esac
  [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ] && sleep 120
done
echo '===RESULT:failed==='

sshPrivateKey.name: SSH Private Key - DMZ Docker Host
